author: THE DECODER

According to the paper, GPT-6 Astra, the bes
summary_en: Researchers from Alibaba and affiliated universities introduced the Co-Design Bench to test AI coding agents on real-world web application modification tasks. author: Nous Research
content_snippet:
We post-trained over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce Western values on a Chinese-trained model. We call this new model Arete-27B.
